name: Gabriel
source: An archangel of Heaven, Gabriel watches over and instructs the cupids working under her. She is supposed to serve as a shining example to her subordinates in both work ethic and personal conduct. In reality, she has a rather noticeable sadistic side towards misbehavers and is not above acting in her own self-interests. This includes hunting down the ultimate flaunter of rules, [url=/c94417/]Lilim[/url], and bringing her back to Heaven...by any means necessary.
